name: DYAMOND II simulation outputs (ICON, IFS, NICAM, UM, SHIELD, GEM, SAM, ARPEGE)
model_or_instrument: ICON, IFS, NICAM, UM, SHIELD, GEM, SAM, ARPEGE
size_as_stated: 285,000 randomly selected samples from each model (160,000 for training, 125,000 for testing); nearly two petabytes per GSRM for original 40 days
resolution: 5 kilometers or less horizontally; 3-hourly snapshots; 15S-15N latitude belt
access: Instructions for acquiring DYAMOND simulation data used to train our models can be found here. Compressed data used for main text and SI figures is publically available at 10.5281/zenodo.8024093.

scales.note: DYAMOND II global storm-resolving models with 2-5 km horizontal resolution, sampled 3-hourly for the 40-day winter period (~2 PB per model).
